tracks.Q1: mechanically falsifiable package/CLI consistency, then independent human and execution validation
tracks.Q2: conditional utility, complementary set selection and network update with preserved regressions

quality_pilot.parents: all 200 fixed D1 original packages; do not inspect D2 cases
quality_pilot.resource_policy: rehash all registered resources, analyze supported text only, never import or execute them
quality_pilot.scope: literal single-parser argparse declarations and local resource references
quality_pilot.eligible_commands: at most 3 deterministically chosen commands per parent that pass supported static checks; report all excluded/unknown counts
quality_pilot.primary_diagnostic: paired intervention-local defect detection with benign false positives and unknown coverage
quality_pilot.ground_truth: known mechanical edit, not overall Skill quality or human gold
quality_pilot.bootstrap_unit: parent Skill; duplicated commands and variants are not independent samples

routing_pilot.data: frozen 192 historical captures: 2 library frames x 32 previously seen tasks x 3 retrieval modes
routing_pilot.similarity: fixed lexical character-bigram/word TF-IDF; DSR-inspired proxy, not published model reproduction
routing_pilot.item_quality: frozen retrieval rank-derived relevance, not intrinsic Skill trust or calibrated probability
forbidden: using gold labels inside the selector

inference.formal_risk_guarantee: none; no independent calibration labels and source exchangeability not established
